content.short: Pavia is a massive cross-chain metaverse experience on Cardano connecting builders and casual gamers.
content.description: Pavia is a leading metaverse project built on the Cardano blockchain, designed to create a vast and interconnected digital world. The platform enables crypto natives, Web3 builders, and casual gamers to explore 3D environments, deploy custom content, and socialize in a decentralized space. Users can own virtual land parcels, build unique structures, and interact with fellow explorers across a web of interconnected hubs. By combining gaming mechanics with blockchain technology, Pavia is defining the future of digital residency and social engagement within the multi-chain metaverse landscape.
content.meta: Pavia is a massive Cardano metaverse for 3D exploration, social hubs, and digital content creation. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
